question_en: Which option correctly distinguishes IUCN, CITES and India's Wild Life (Protection) Act (WPA)?
question_te: IUCN, CITES, India Wild Life (Protection) Act (WPA) మధ్య సరైన distinction ఏది?

options_en.a: IUCN regulates trade; CITES estimates extinction risk; WPA applies only outside India
options_en.b: IUCN estimates global extinction risk; CITES regulates international trade; WPA provides domestic legal protection
options_en.c: All three assign the same conservation status
options_en.d: CITES and WPA are scientific assessments, whereas IUCN is a trade treaty

options_te.a: IUCN tradeను regulate చేస్తుంది; CITES extinction riskను estimate చేస్తుంది; WPA India బయట మాత్రమే వర్తిస్తుంది
options_te.b: IUCN global extinction riskను estimate చేస్తుంది; CITES international tradeను regulate చేస్తుంది; WPA domestic legal protection ఇస్తుంది
options_te.c: మూడు systems ఒకే conservation statusను assign చేస్తాయి
options_te.d: CITES, WPA scientific assessments; IUCN trade treaty

explanation_en: The three systems answer different questions: biological risk, international trade and legal protection within India. Their labels are not interchangeable.
explanation_te: IUCN biological extinction riskను, CITES international tradeను, WPA Indiaలో legal protectionను address చేస్తాయి. వాటి labels interchangeable కావు.

question_en: A species is listed as EN by IUCN, in a CITES Appendix, and in a WPA Schedule. What is the best interpretation?
question_te: ఒక species IUCNలో ENగా, CITES Appendixలో, WPA Scheduleలో listed ఉంది. సరైన interpretation ఏది?

options_en.a: The three labels independently describe risk, trade control and Indian legal protection
options_en.b: EN automatically fixes its CITES Appendix and WPA Schedule
options_en.c: Only the WPA label has any conservation meaning
options_en.d: The three listings contradict one another

options_te.a: మూడు labels వరుసగా risk, trade control, Indian legal protection అనే వేర్వేరు విషయాలు చెబుతాయి
options_te.b: EN category దాని CITES Appendix, WPA Scheduleను automatically fix చేస్తుంది
options_te.c: WPA labelకు మాత్రమే conservation meaning ఉంది

explanation_en: A species can legitimately carry all three labels because each system has a different purpose; one does not mechanically determine the others.
explanation_te: ప్రతి system purpose వేరు కాబట్టి ఒక speciesకు మూడు labels ఉండవచ్చు. ఒక label నుంచి మిగతావి automatically నిర్ణయించలేం.

question_en: Which statement most precisely distinguishes Extinct in the Wild (EW) from Extinct (EX)?
question_te: Extinct in the Wild (EW), Extinct (EX) మధ్య precise distinction ఏది?

options_en.a: EW means a declining wild population; EX means a stable captive population
options_en.b: EW means survival only in captivity, cultivation or a naturalised population outside the native range; EX means no reasonable doubt that the last individual has died
options_en.c: EW and EX differ only in population size
options_en.d: EW applies only to plants and EX only to animals

options_te.a: EW అంటే declining wild population; EX అంటే stable captive population
options_te.b: EW అంటే captivity, cultivationలో లేదా native range బయట naturalised populationగా మాత్రమే survival; EX అంటే last individual చనిపోయిందనే reasonable doubt లేకపోవడం
options_te.c: EW, EX మధ్య difference population size మాత్రమే
options_te.d: EW plantsకు, EX animalsకు మాత్రమే వర్తిస్తాయి

explanation_en: EW still permits living individuals outside the native wild state. EX requires exhaustive evidence supporting the loss of the last individual.
explanation_te: EWలో living individuals ఉండవచ్చు, కానీ native wild stateలో ఉండరు. EXకు last individual కూడా లేకపోయిందనే strong evidence అవసరం.

question_en: Under IUCN Criterion A1, what are the population-reduction thresholds for CR, EN and VU respectively?
question_te: IUCN Criterion A1లో CR, EN, VU population-reduction thresholds వరుసగా ఏవి?
explanation_en: Criterion A1 uses 90%, 70% and 50% for CR, EN and VU. The lower 80%, 50% and 30% set applies to A2–A4.
explanation_te: A1లో CR–EN–VU thresholds 90–70–50%. A2–A4కు 80–50–30% set వర్తిస్తుంది.

question_en: Consider the following statements about IUCN criteria: 1. The assessment period under Criterion A is ten years or three generations, whichever is longer. 2. Criterion D may identify risk from an extremely small population even without a demonstrated current decline. Which is correct?
question_te: IUCN criteria గురించి statements చూడండి: 1. Criterion A assessment period పది years లేదా మూడు generations—ఏది ఎక్కువైతే అది. 2. Current decline prove కాకపోయినా extremely small populationను Criterion D riskగా గుర్తించవచ్చు. సరైనది ఏది?
explanation_en: Both statements reflect how the criteria operate: Criterion A uses the longer time window, while Criterion D can act on extreme smallness itself.
explanation_te: రెండు statements correct. Criterion A longer time windowను తీసుకుంటుంది; Criterion D extreme smallnessనే risk indicatorగా use చేయగలదు.

question_en: Which of the following are objectives of Project Elephant? 1. Conserving wild Asian elephants 2. Securing habitats and movement corridors 3. Managing human–elephant conflict 4. Promoting captive-elephant welfare
question_te: Project Elephant objectivesలో ఏవి ఉన్నాయి? 1. Wild Asian elephants conservation 2. Habitats, movement corridors protection 3. Human–elephant conflict management 4. Captive-elephant welfare
explanation_en: Project Elephant is broader than population counting: its remit includes wild elephants, habitat connectivity, conflict mitigation and captive-elephant welfare.
explanation_te: Project Elephant countingకే పరిమితం కాదు. Wild elephants, habitat connectivity, conflict mitigation, captive welfare—all four దీని scopeలో ఉన్నాయి.

question_en: Assertion (A): A scientifically advanced elephant estimate alone cannot fulfil Project Elephant's entire mandate. Reason (R): The project also covers corridors, conflict management and captive-elephant welfare.
question_te: Assertion (A): Scientifically advanced elephant estimate ఒక్కటే Project Elephant మొత్తం mandateను fulfil చేయదు. Reason (R): Project scopeలో corridors, conflict management, captive-elephant welfare కూడా ఉన్నాయి.

options_en.a: Both A and R are true, and R correctly explains A
options_en.b: Both A and R are true, but R does not explain A
options_en.c: A is true, but R is false
options_en.d: A is false, but R is true

options_te.a: A, R రెండూ true; R అనేది Aకు correct explanation
options_te.b: A, R రెండూ true; కానీ R correct explanation కాదు

explanation_en: Population estimation supplies evidence, but the project's mandate also requires habitat, connectivity, conflict and welfare action.
explanation_te: Population estimate evidence ఇస్తుంది; కానీ Project mandateలో habitat, connectivity, conflict, welfare actions కూడా అవసరం. అందుకే R, Aను explain చేస్తుంది.

question_en: Which set of statements about the 2025 Asiatic-lion estimation is correct? 1. It was Gujarat's sixteenth estimation. 2. It recorded 891 lions, compared with 674 in 2020. 3. Every recorded lion lived inside a protected area.
question_te: 2025 Asiatic-lion estimation గురించి సరైన statements ఏవి? 1. ఇది Gujarat 16th estimation. 2. 891 lions నమోదయ్యాయి; 2020లో 674. 3. Recorded lions అన్నీ protected areasలోనే ఉన్నాయి.
explanation_en: The first two statements are correct. Many Asiatic lions were recorded outside protected-area boundaries.
explanation_te: Statements 1, 2 correct. Many Asiatic lions protected-area boundaries బయట కూడా ఉన్నాయి; కాబట్టి statement 3 wrong.

question_en: Match the following: 1. Project Lion announcement 2. Ten-year financial-outlay approval 3. Supreme Court Kuno translocation direction; a. 2013 b. 15 August 2020 c. 1 March 2025
question_te: Match చేయండి: 1. Project Lion announcement 2. Ten-year financial-outlay approval 3. Supreme Court Kuno translocation direction; a. 2013 b. 15 August 2020 c. 1 March 2025
explanation_en: Project Lion was announced on 15 August 2020; its ten-year outlay was approved on 1 March 2025; the Kuno direction dates to 2013.
explanation_te: Project Lion announcement 15 August 2020; ten-year outlay approval 1 March 2025; Kuno direction 2013.

question_en: Which combination contains only major threats to snow leopards identified in the lesson?
question_te: Lessonలో identify చేసిన major snow-leopard threats మాత్రమే ఉన్న combination ఏది?

options_en.a: Retaliatory killing, poaching, wild-prey depletion and competition with livestock
options_en.b: Veterinary diclofenac, trawl nets, power-line collision and sand mining
options_en.c: Ocean acidification, coral bleaching, by-catch and oil spills
options_en.d: Only high-altitude cold and natural ageing

options_te.a: Retaliatory killing, poaching, wild-prey depletion, livestock competition
options_te.b: Veterinary diclofenac, trawl nets, power-line collision, sand mining
options_te.c: Ocean acidification, coral bleaching, by-catch, oil spills

explanation_en: Livestock-related retaliation, poaching, declining wild prey and livestock competition are the specified pressures.
explanation_te: Livestock loss తరువాత retaliation, poaching, wild prey తగ్గడం, livestock competition ఇవే specified major threats.

question_en: Which pairing correctly describes Project Crocodile?
question_te: Project Crocodileను correctly describe చేసే pairing ఏది?
explanation_en: Project Crocodile began in 1975 as a cooperative programme involving the Government of India, UNDP and FAO.
explanation_te: Project Crocodile 1975లో Government of India, UNDP, FAO cooperationతో ప్రారంభమైంది.

question_en: More than 7,000 crocodilian releases were reported by Project Crocodile's fiftieth anniversary in 2025. Which conclusion is most defensible?
question_te: Project Crocodile 50th anniversary అయిన 2025 నాటికి 7,000కుపైగా crocodilian releases report అయ్యాయి. Most defensible conclusion ఏది?

options_en.a: All three species consequently moved to Least Concern
options_en.b: Release effort was substantial, but recovery remained uneven across species
options_en.c: Release totals alone prove that every habitat threat ended
options_en.d: The gharial recovered more strongly than the mugger and saltwater crocodile

options_te.a: దీంతో మూడు species అన్నీ Least Concernకు మారాయి
options_te.b: Release effort substantialగా ఉంది; కానీ species మధ్య recovery unevenగా ఉంది
options_te.c: Release total alone వల్ల అన్ని habitat threats ముగిశాయని prove అవుతుంది
options_te.d: Gharial recovery, mugger–saltwater crocodile కంటే stronger

explanation_en: Mugger and saltwater crocodile populations improved substantially, but the gharial remained Critically Endangered; release volume is not equal to uniform recovery.
explanation_te: Mugger, saltwater crocodile populations improve అయ్యాయి; gharial మాత్రం CRలోనే ఉంది. High release number అంటే uniform recovery కాదు.

question_en: Assertion (A): Habitat loss should not be presented as the principal cause of the catastrophic Gyps-vulture collapse in India. Reason (R): The chief documented driver was poisoning after vultures consumed carcasses of livestock treated with veterinary diclofenac.
question_te: Assertion (A): Indiaలో catastrophic Gyps-vulture collapseకు habitat lossనే principal causeగా చెప్పకూడదు. Reason (R): Veterinary diclofenac ఇచ్చిన livestock carcasses తినడం వల్ల poisoning chief documented driver.

options_en.a: Both A and R are true, and R correctly explains A
options_en.b: Both A and R are true, but R does not explain A
options_en.c: A is true, but R is false
options_en.d: A is false, but R is true

options_te.a: A, R రెండూ true; R అనేది Aకు correct explanation
options_te.b: A, R రెండూ true; కానీ R explanation కాదు

explanation_en: Diclofenac-contaminated carcasses, not habitat loss, were the principal cause identified for the rapid collapse.
explanation_te: Rapid collapseకు principal identified cause diclofenac-contaminated carcasses; habitat loss కాదు. అందువల్ల R, Aను correctly explain చేస్తుంది.

question_en: India prohibited veterinary use of diclofenac in which year as a key vulture-conservation measure?
question_te: Vulture conservationలో key measureగా India veterinary diclofenac useను ఏ yearలో ban చేసింది?
explanation_en: India banned veterinary diclofenac in 2006 after its lethal role in Gyps-vulture declines was established.
explanation_te: Gyps vultures declineలో lethal role establish అయిన తరువాత India veterinary diclofenacను 2006లో ban చేసింది.

question_en: A conservation planner argues that the rise from 674 Asiatic lions in 2020 to 891 in 2025 has eliminated systemic risk. Which response is strongest?
question_te: 2020లో 674 నుంచి 2025లో 891కు Asiatic lions పెరగడంతో systemic risk పూర్తిగా తొలగిందని planner అంటున్నారు. Strongest response ఏది?

options_en.a: Correct, because population growth always removes geographic risk
options_en.b: Incorrect, because the only wild population remains concentrated in the Greater Gir landscape
options_en.c: Correct, because every lion now lives inside a National Park
options_en.d: Incorrect only because the species is absent from Barda

options_te.a: Correct; population growth geographic riskను ఎప్పుడూ remove చేస్తుంది
options_te.b: Incorrect; only wild population ఇంకా Greater Gir landscapeలో concentratedగా ఉంది
options_te.c: Correct; అన్ని lions ఇప్పుడు National Parkలోనే ఉన్నాయి
options_te.d: Bardaలో species లేకపోవడం వల్ల మాత్రమే incorrect

explanation_en: Numerical growth is encouraging, but concentration of the entire wild population in one landscape preserves correlated disease, disaster and habitat risks.
explanation_te: Number పెరగడం positive; కానీ entire wild population ఒకే landscapeలో concentration వల్ల disease, disaster, habitat risks ఇంకా correlatedగానే ఉంటాయి.

question_en: A field team records signs and camera-trap detections from sampled locations, then uses a spatial model to infer the total population. Why is the result described as an estimate rather than a census?
question_te: Field team sampled locationsలో signs, camera-trap detections collect చేసి, spatial modelతో total populationను infer చేసింది. దీన్ని census కాకుండా estimate అని ఎందుకు అంటారు?

options_en.a: Because an estimate infers the total from sampled evidence, whereas a census attempts a direct count where feasible
options_en.b: Because every camera-trap exercise is legally prohibited from being called a census
options_en.c: Because a census never records individual animals
options_en.d: Because estimates do not require a survey year or method

options_te.a: Estimate sample evidence నుంచి totalను infer చేస్తుంది; census feasible అయినప్పుడు direct countకు ప్రయత్నిస్తుంది
options_te.b: Camera-trap exerciseను census అనడం legally prohibited కాబట్టి
options_te.c: Census individual animalsను ఎప్పుడూ record చేయదు కాబట్టి
options_te.d: Estimateకు survey year, method అవసరం లేదు కాబట్టి

explanation_en: The distinction rests on method: direct enumeration where feasible versus inference from sampled evidence. AITE integrates WII–NTCA field signs, camera traps, spatial models and habitat information.
explanation_te: Difference methodలో ఉంది: feasible అయితే direct enumeration census; sample evidence నుంచి inference estimate. AITEలో WII–NTCA field signs, camera traps, spatial models, habitat informationను integrate చేస్తాయి.
